AdmittedApparatusBindingModel.description:
Pre-run apparatus selection intent pinned by manifest and realization envelope.

SVR-029 envelope-governed realization: the entry pins selected apparatus
claims. It is admitted intent, never a fabricated, observed
``ExperimentApparatusContextModel``.
AdmittedApparatusBindingModel.title: AdmittedApparatusBindingModel

AdmittedBindingModel.description:
One admitted binding: an authoritative descriptor plus admitted origin.

This is admitted intent, not realized provenance; #790 and the run contract
own actual realization.
AdmittedBindingModel.title: AdmittedBindingModel

AdmittedExecutionControlModel.description:
Minimal schedule-independent attempt policy.

Carries only whole-trial attempt timeout, the required cancellation/timeout
disposition, and the cleanup-plan reference. The reset/compensation retry
policy is owned by the referenced ``TrialCleanupPlanModel.retry_policy`` and
is not duplicated here, so a sealed plan cannot hold two contradicting retry
policies. It never carries worker, queue, placement, host, lease, or mutable
status data.
AdmittedExecutionControlModel.title: AdmittedExecutionControlModel

AdmittedInstantiationProvenanceModel.description: Plan/run/family linkage that becomes instantiated-snapshot identity (SVR-025).
AdmittedInstantiationProvenanceModel.title: AdmittedInstantiationProvenanceModel

AdmittedSelectionRecordModel.description: One resolved variation selection with its selection-policy origin as provenance.
AdmittedSelectionRecordModel.title: AdmittedSelectionRecordModel

AdmittedTrialEntryModel.description: One immutable admitted trial entry at a unique logical coordinate.
AdmittedTrialEntryModel.title: AdmittedTrialEntryModel

x-raes-invariants.description: An admitted trial entry keeps run_id distinct from plan_entry_id, records unique resolved variation selections and non-exhausted stochastic draws, matches its instantiation provenance to the entry identity, and binds its content with a recomputed entry_digest.

AdmittedTrialPlanAdmissionModel.description:
Bounded admission success facts and limitations.

A sealed plan may carry safe success-stage/count facts and limitations plus
bounded diagnostics; it never carries failed partial entries or raw
validation payloads. The portable lifecycle has exactly one successful
state — admitted and sealed — so ``admitted_at_stage`` is a closed literal
and a caller cannot seal a plan marked ``partial``/``failed``.
AdmittedTrialPlanAdmissionModel.title: AdmittedTrialPlanAdmissionModel

AdmittedTrialPlanInputRefsModel.description: Pinned, digest-bound references to the admitted plan's exact inputs (SVR-023).
AdmittedTrialPlanInputRefsModel.title: AdmittedTrialPlanInputRefsModel

AdmittedTrialPlanProfilesModel.description:
Exact versioned profile set fixing the plan's compatibility surface.

ADR-084 extensibility seam: a new coordinate dimension, identity algorithm,
random transform, cleanup action, or execution-control policy adds one
governed profile version, never a generic parameter bag. Each field is a
closed literal of the versions this contract implements, so the *published*
JSON Schema — not just the Python validator — encodes the supported set as a
``const``/``enum`` and every implementation fails closed on an unknown
canonicalization, integrity, isolation, cleanup, or execution-control
profile. A new profile version adds a literal alternative here together with
the semantics that implement it.
AdmittedTrialPlanProfilesModel.title: AdmittedTrialPlanProfilesModel

ApparatusBindingTargetModel.description: Canonical target declared by a selected portable apparatus manifest.
ApparatusBindingTargetModel.title: ApparatusBindingTargetModel

BindingOwnerModel.description: Governed contract and validator profile that owns one binding.
BindingOwnerModel.title: BindingOwnerModel

BindingScalarType.description: Exact JSON scalar type declared by a binding owner.
BindingScalarType.title: BindingScalarType

CleanStateRequirementModel.description: Pre-execution state requirement without claiming universal reversal.
CleanStateRequirementModel.title: CleanStateRequirementModel

CleanupObligationModel.description: One portable cleanup action and the conditions under which it is owed.
CleanupObligationModel.title: CleanupObligationModel

CleanupResourceBoundaryModel.description: Owned resource scope to which cleanup and restoration claims are bounded.
CleanupResourceBoundaryModel.title: CleanupResourceBoundaryModel

DiagnosticModel.description: Closed portable diagnostic shape for published contracts.
DiagnosticModel.title: DiagnosticModel

ExecutionRetryPolicyModel.description: Retry posture after an execution attempt may have produced effects.
ExecutionRetryPolicyModel.title: ExecutionRetryPolicyModel

ExperimentBindingDescriptorModel.description: One explicit factor/condition value bound to one authoritative target.
ExperimentBindingDescriptorModel.title: ExperimentBindingDescriptorModel

ExperimentManifestReferenceModel.description: Reference constrained to an apparatus or capability manifest.
ExperimentManifestReferenceModel.title: ExperimentManifestReferenceModel

x-raes-invariants.description: Manifest digest qualifiers are limited to processor/backend manifest refs that can be checked against concrete manifest payload digests; manifest path qualifiers are not accepted in v1.

ExperimentReferenceModel.description: Typed reference to an experiment-core or adjacent RAES artifact.
ExperimentReferenceModel.title: ExperimentReferenceModel

ExperimentScenarioFamilyReferenceModel.description: Digest-pinned identity of one semantically admitted expanded SDL family.
ExperimentScenarioFamilyReferenceModel.title: ExperimentScenarioFamilyReferenceModel

ExperimentSelectionOrderOutcomeModel.description: One complete canonical order of declared structural member ids.
ExperimentSelectionOrderOutcomeModel.title: ExperimentSelectionOrderOutcomeModel

ExperimentSelectionReferenceOutcomeModel.description: One governed-reference outcome named by its declared reference id.
ExperimentSelectionReferenceOutcomeModel.title: ExperimentSelectionReferenceOutcomeModel

ExperimentSelectionSubsetOutcomeModel.description: One canonical subset of declared structural member ids.
ExperimentSelectionSubsetOutcomeModel.title: ExperimentSelectionSubsetOutcomeModel

ExperimentStochasticControlModel.description: Seed, randomization, sampling, or scheduler control for reproducibility.
ExperimentStochasticControlModel.title: ExperimentStochasticControlModel

ExperimentTaskReferenceModel.description: Reference constrained to an experiment task.
ExperimentTaskReferenceModel.title: ExperimentTaskReferenceModel

GovernedEntropyRefModel.description:
Governed reference to sensitive root entropy; never carries raw bytes.

Raw entropy is resolved only at an authorized in-process boundary (out of
scope here) and is never serialized back into this model, a diagnostic, a
fixture, argv, or telemetry (SVR-028).
GovernedEntropyRefModel.title: GovernedEntropyRefModel

GovernedRandomOutcomeRefModel.description: Governed reference to a sensitive drawn outcome; never carries the raw value.
GovernedRandomOutcomeRefModel.title: GovernedRandomOutcomeRefModel

IsolationDimensionEvidenceModel.description: Evidence for one bounded-parallelism isolation dimension.
IsolationDimensionEvidenceModel.title: IsolationDimensionEvidenceModel

LiteralBindingValueModel.description: Portable literal value; strict type validation occurs at its descriptor.
LiteralBindingValueModel.title: LiteralBindingValueModel

ParticipantImplementationBindingTargetMo.description: Canonical target declared by one selected participant implementation.
ParticipantImplementationBindingTargetMo.title: ParticipantImplementationBindingTargetModel

PublicRandomOutcomeModel.description: Public drawn value, recorded as canonical text.
PublicRandomOutcomeModel.title: PublicRandomOutcomeModel

PublicSeedModel.description:
Inline public root-entropy seed: fixed-width canonical hex bytes.

Fixed-width lowercase hex removes leading-zero, integer-width, sign, and
Unicode ambiguity from the executable entropy encoding (per the EXP-718
preflight's "Canonical Inputs" section).
PublicSeedModel.title: PublicSeedModel

RandomStreamControlBindingModel.description:
Executable binding: profile identity, namespace, and root entropy.

A seed alone, without generator/derivation/transform identity, is not a
reproducibility claim (SVR-012). ``profile_ref`` is required and
structurally constrained to ``ref_kind="profile"``.
RandomStreamControlBindingModel.title: RandomStreamControlBindingModel

RandomStreamDrawRecordModel.description:
Archival draw provenance: address, transform identity, outcome, and rejection facts.

References its control rather than duplicating the root seed for every
draw, and never exposes raw generator blocks outside the conformance
vector corpus.
RandomStreamDrawRecordModel.title: RandomStreamDrawRecordModel

x-raes-invariants.description: outcome must be present exactly when rejection_exhausted is false, and absent when true.

RandomStreamProfileReferenceModel.description: Reference constrained to an accepted random-stream profile.
RandomStreamProfileReferenceModel.title: RandomStreamProfileReferenceModel

RealizationEnvelopeIdentityModel.description: Immutable realization-envelope identity carried across runtime contracts.
RealizationEnvelopeIdentityModel.title: RealizationEnvelopeIdentityModel

ScenarioBindingTargetModel.description: Canonical target owned by a composed SDL scenario family.
ScenarioBindingTargetModel.title: ScenarioBindingTargetModel

SchedulerIsolationProofModel.description: Schedule-independent proof permitting a bounded parallelism request.
SchedulerIsolationProofModel.title: SchedulerIsolationProofModel

x-raes-invariants.description: Scheduling defaults to serial; bounded parallelism requires independent evidence for range, capacity, ports, storage, control-plane locks, secret scope, and cleanup.

SecretReferenceBindingValueModel.description: Non-sensitive identity of a secret resolved only at an authorized sink.
SecretReferenceBindingValueModel.title: SecretReferenceBindingValueModel

StreamAddressModel.description:
Closed semantic random-draw address (SVR-013).

A pure canonical function of the randomness namespace, logical trial
coordinate, selection-policy id, variation-point id, draw purpose, and a
stable local draw coordinate. It is not a concatenated string, arbitrary
mapping, JSON Pointer, or scheduler/compiled-runtime address, and it
admits no worker/process/thread/host, wall-time, retry, or aggregate
experiment-digest field (``extra="forbid"`` closes the shape).
StreamAddressModel.title: StreamAddressModel

x-raes-invariants.description: draw_purpose must be a term from the random_streams.draw_purpose controlled vocabulary.

TrialCleanupPlanModel.description: Schedule-independent cleanup intent carried by one admitted trial entry.
TrialCleanupPlanModel.title: TrialCleanupPlanModel

x-raes-invariants.description: Cleanup boundary and dependency references resolve, ordering is acyclic, required cleanup is verifiable, and retries after non-idempotent effects declare required retry-triggered reset obligations covering the affected boundaries or compensation.

TrialCoordinateModel.description:
Logical trial coordinate dimensions usable in a random-stream address.

Every field is an optional portable identifier: an experiment declares
only the dimensions it actually varies (SVR-013's "logical trial
coordinate").
TrialCoordinateModel.title: TrialCoordinateModel

description: Immutable, schedule-independent admitted trial plan (SCE-002/SCE-006, ADR-084).
title: AdmittedTrialPlanModel

x-raes-invariants.description: An admitted trial plan keeps map keys equal to embedded ids, keeps plan/entry/run identities distinct, gives every entry a unique logical coordinate and archival run_id, resolves cleanup and stochastic-control joins (with each draw addressed to its entry coordinate) and isolation-proof entries within the sealed plan, requires values duplicated from incumbent authorities (random-stream profile, binding condition/family) to agree, forbids bounded-parallel entries from sharing resources, matches admission cardinality, and binds the complete plan with a recomputed plan_digest over the entry set.
